clusters.headline: Foreign Nationals Arrested At South African Airport Over Ukraine
aiSummaryBullets: Nine foreign nationals were detained by South African police while attempting to depart the country.
Authorities allege that the individuals intended to travel to Ukraine to participate in the ongoing conflict.

clusters.headline: African National Congress Faces Losses In South African Local Polls
aiSummaryBullets: The African National Congress is currently facing a difficult result in the latest local elections.
Election officials have processed 80 percent of the ballots cast across the nation.
